name: inventario-local-core
description: Sistema de Inventario Local White-Label (Monorepo: Backend SQLite + Frontend React + Desktop Tauri)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACK,FRONT -c blue,green "npm --workspace=@inventario-local/backend run dev" "npm --workspace=@inventario-local/frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@inventario-local/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace=@inventario-local/backend run typecheck && npm --workspace=@inventario-local/frontend run typecheck
scripts.db:setup: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate && npm --workspace=@inventario-local/backend exec -- prisma migrate deploy && npm run db:seed
